description: Authorized corrective mission proving the Runtime automatically qualifies and executes a corrective mission from runtime/missions/pending/ once it is authorized. Read-only (no code modification, no patch, no provider): the repaired mechanism is AutonomyRuntimeAdapter.readCorrectiveQueue, exercised end-to-end by the autonomy loop that selects and releases this mission ahead of roadmap progress.

objectives.goal: Confirm the pending corrective queue is enumerated and this authorized mission is folded into the autonomy work-list.
done_when: Authorized corrective mission is selected by the autonomy loop before roadmap missions.

objectives.goal: Drive the authorized corrective mission to RELEASE through the existing local pipeline and Release Manager.
done_when: A proven ledger entry is recorded for this mission.

definition_of_done: The autonomy loop executed a corrective mission taken from the pending queue.
completion: Corrective-queue intake is demonstrated by a proven ledger entry.
